#+TITLE: Reviewed frontend regression oracle

This is one selected input/output oracle, captured before deleting the model
stdout projector. It contains the exact authored model input, its digest, all
owned header/Make parameter values, source observations, and reference tool/run
digests. The reference ran through the existing sealed five-stage Recipe under
its unchanged 120-second budget. Both source checks and the terminal ASCENT
inventory completed successfully.

The fixture is maintained test input, not a portable raw command history or a
claim that its original execution cache is available. Regression replay needs
only this input and the pinned SDK provider; no original cache locator is read.
The SDK must reproduce the complete field inventories for both the frozen input
and the selected current model. Missing, changed or extra values refuse reuse.

The old engine identity and tool digests explain how expectations were selected.
They do not qualify an old runtime, package speedup, or arbitrary future models.
Changes to this oracle require independent reference review; the new adapter
never writes or re-signs its own expected values.

* Independent policy/flow retirement oracle

=research-policy-baseline.json= was captured before deleting the two standalone
entries. It records their source hashes, native CLI policy/class/flow parameter
observations, the old native ASCENT results for all 21 publication cases, and
all seven old evaluate_flow control outcomes. No run cache path is required to
replay it. The shared implementation must not update its own expected results.
The only permitted policy-data difference is removal of the two explicitly
retired generator exemptions; artifact classes and safety booleans are preserved.
Old source hashes are provenance for retired files, not claims those source
paths still exist. Complete raw commands/logs remain outside Git.

* Structural renderer relocation and completed amendment

=architecture-view-relocation.json= retains pre-relocation source identity, AST
hashes and eight independently observed helper controls. It is not a full source
copy or raw export cache. The inverse-context AST test preserves the original
post-export rendering algorithms. The current real renderer failure is a source
anchor refusal, not a passing complete-view check.

=structure.sysml= and =structure-reference.json= provide one independently
captured native CLI structural graph digest for managed SDK conversion checks.
This fixture does not certify the entire DEV model or all SDK conversions.

=darwin-target-amendment.json= records the completed one-shot source amendment's
identity and exact remaining text occurrences. Its old producer is retired; the
fixture authorizes a read-only regression check, never replay of source mutation.

* Workspace context cohort

=workspace-context-migration.json= is a reviewed source-migration input, not a
raw command history. It records 123 pre-migration source hashes, AST identities,
workspace read counts and exact numeric-control inventories. Every prior AST
identity was checked before a further pure helper-assignment deletion was
recorded. The expected retained algorithms are not generated from successful
native output, and no historical proof result is substituted. Full inverse AST
and numeric-control checks run both independently in tests and through the
shared policy capability. Conditional source equivalence does not certify full
study execution, native process teardown or missing proof payloads.
